how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:engineering-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3526:obj:0: If you wish to learn more about ⟦E1⟧, take the Manual of ⟦E2⟧ Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:3526:details:0: Expert engineering yields two distinct disciplines: gnome and goblin. Clearly, goblin engineering is the choice of all brilliant engineers. Learn to master the world through the judicious use of high explosives and fantastic gear!
rows.quest:3526:details:1: B⟦1⟧, read this manual. If you want to learn about goblin engineering, then take it to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan. Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure this is what you want before finishing his task.
rows.quest:3526:completion:0: Well ⟦2⟧, you were wise to seek my tutelage! Any schlep can become an expert at the basics of engineering - the gnomes and their irradiated home of Gnomeregan are proof of that. It takes a strong mind and a steady hand (emphasis on STEADY) though to master the discipline of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:3526:completion:1: BKeep your ears perked ⟦3⟧, and you might learn something.

rows.quest:3630:completion:0: Ah, a young engineer interested in pursuing the one, true discipline of engineering! Well forgive my melodrama, friend. While our situation remains dire, it still is always a good day to see another engineer respond to the clarion call of true engineering!

rows.quest:3635:completion:0: You've come to learn about ⟦E5⟧, eh? Well, you've come to the right gnome. While the ruling faction of Gnomeregan may use politics to ostracize those they view as an intellectual threat, they know that knowledge is something they cannot control.
rows.quest:3635:completion:1: BThey and I both know that when I left Gnomeregan, they lost one of their greatest gnome engineers alive today. If you're a capable student, I'll teach you what I know.

rows.quest:3638:obj:0: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:3638:details:0: Goblin engineering is about practical uses for high profit and higher explosive power! Our schemata allow us to make powerful bombs and mighty weaponry; the manual you read covered this.
rows.quest:3638:details:1: BThe manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. Once you become a goblin engineer, that's that. There is no access to ⟦E5⟧ at all.
rows.quest:3638:details:2: BIf you still want to become a goblin engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again. Think about it carefully, ⟦15⟧.
rows.quest:3638:completion:0: Welcome aboard, Goblin Engineer ⟦16⟧! You soon will have access to the most powerful engineering schemata anywhere on ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:3638:completion:1: BNow that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your goblin-oriented engineering work. From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your goblin engineering talents!
rows.quest:3639:obj:0: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:3639:details:0: As your mentor, I want samples of your work. You're a skilled engineer; there is no question of this, ⟦17⟧. What I hope to do though is analyze them for ways to emphasize goblin-oriented techniques in your future efforts. I need the following: twenty big iron bombs, twenty sticks of solid dynamite, and five explosive sheep - and keep the safeties armed!
rows.quest:3639:details:1: BSubmit these items to me and I will issue you your own Goblin Engineer Membership Card; it is required for access to all goblin engineering trainers!
rows.quest:3639:completion:0: Here is your first Goblin Engineer Membership Card!
rows.quest:3639:completion:1: BThis card has its dues paid for in advance for fourteen days; all cards expire after two weeks of activity. When it does, pay your next set of dues to any goblin engineer trainer in order to get another card; without the card, your membership will temporarily lapse and you cannot access new schemata.
rows.quest:3639:completion:2: BThis never affects what you already know; once a goblin engineer, always a goblin engineer.
rows.quest:3640:obj:0: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Tinkmaster Overspark in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3640:details:0: Gnome engineering is about engineering theory shaped to serve our needs! Our schemata allow us to make devices that control the world around us; the manual you read covered this.
rows.quest:3640:details:1: BThe manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. Once you become a gnome engineer, that's that. There is no access to goblin engineering at all.

rows.quest:3640:completion:1: BNow that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your gnome-oriented engineering work. From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your ⟦E5⟧ talents!
